properties.flow: cookie.session → sessions(token+expiry_check) → users(lookup) → request.user. authMiddleware: strict 401 on failure. optionalAuthMiddleware: silent skip. adminGuard: 403 if role != admin. Must run authMiddleware before adminGuard.

properties.semantic: Each key unlocks exactly one target: either an AI model provider (providerId → ai_providers) OR an MCP server (mcpId → mcps). provider (legacy string column) is retained for backward compatibility. aiProviders.isFree determines who may hold the key (any user vs paid tier only). mcps.api_type='api' triggers MCP-API-Key placeholder substitution.

error_fix: running → ready (prompt built) → client dispatches to agent → completed

hyperedges.label: Bridge Pattern with Ref-Counted Process Managers
hyperedges.description: BridgeInterface defines executeTask/streamResponse/cancelExecution. Both OpenCodeBridge and KiroBridge implement it. OpenCodeBridge delegates instance lifecycle to OpenCodeProcessManager (ref-counted, idle timeout, Graceful shutdown); KiroBridge delegates to KiroProcessManager (simple spawn). LiteLLMProcessManager follows the same ref-counted pattern as OpenCodeProcessManager. BridgeRegistry registers and exposes both bridges.

hyperedges.label: Real-time SSE Streaming with Late-Joiner Buffer
hyperedges.description: OpenCode SSEConnection consumes /event endpoint, transforms OpenCodeEvent -> StreamEvent, buffers non-terminal events for late-joining clients. SubscriptionManager manages connections per directory. SessionEventBus provides the same pattern for KiroBridge (bridge-agnostic). SSE route in agentRoutes subscribes to the appropriate bus based on bridge type.

hyperedges.label: Agent Message Send Flow (Provisioning + Execution)
hyperedges.description: On POST /messages: agentRoutes validates token balance (token-service), resolves model, provisions LiteLLM proxy if non-zen provider (LiteLLMProcessManager), pre-creates OpenCode session (OpenCodeProcessManager → OpenCodeBridge.createOrResolveSession), writes provider configs, then fire-and-forget launches agentExecutor.execute with full context. Refresh-proof via optimistic DB write of user message + running status before provisioning.

hyperedges.label: Agent Execution Pipeline
hyperedges.summary: AgentExecutor runs bridge.streamResponse, reconciles tokens via resolveModelById → calculateActualCost → reconcileTokens.

hyperedges.label: NIM Prompt Engineering
hyperedges.summary: NimEngine drives three prompt workflows (enhance, refine, error-fix) all backed by nimChat calls to NIM provider.

hyperedges.label: Graphify Build Lifecycle
hyperedges.summary: Session-end, workspace-open, and tier-change hooks converge on buildProjectGraph / removeProjectGraph; skill management delegates to provider-config for isolated paths.

hyperedges.label: Admin Page Group
hyperedges.description: All admin pages share a consistent layout pattern (h1 title + subtitle, centered loading/empty states, table-based data display with hover rows). They use the use-admin and use-ai-admin hook families exclusively. The admin panel routes to 4 sub-pages: overview (metrics), projects (read-only listing), users (full CRUD with token/tier/CodeRabbit/Kiro management), and ai-runtime (providers/models/MCPs management).

hyperedges.label: Three-Panel Workspace Layout
hyperedges.description: Both WorkspacePage and CommunityProjectPage implement a 3-panel layout: chat panel, file tree panel, code editor panel. WorkspacePage is full-featured (editable, streaming AI, git integration, graphify). CommunityProjectPage is read-only (viewer mode with access control gates, like/fork/download). Both support mobile/desktop tab navigation and have layoutMode (chat-first vs code-first). Both use Monaco editor, markdown rendering, and file tree components.

hyperedges.label: Project Management Flow
hyperedges.description: Dashboard lists all projects and links to creation (NewProjectPage with 5-step wizard: info, platform, build, AI tool, source), workspace (full IDE with AI chat), and settings (ProjectMenuPage with overview/stats/compiler/settings tabs). All project pages use useProjects or useProject hooks. NewProjectPage supports blank/zip/github sources with GitHub OAuth flow. Settings tab handles visibility toggling (paid-gated private projects) and deletion.

hyperedges.label: Authentication flow: useAuth queries /auth/me, syncs to useAuthStore; Navbar reads user/logout; ProtectedRoute/AdminRoute/GuestRoute guard routes based on auth state
Layout hierarchy: RootLayout→Outlet; PublicLayout composes Navbar+Footer+Outlet; AppLayout and AdminLayout compose Navbar+Outlet
Graphify feature: GraphifyControls uses useGraphify hook which talks to /projects/:id/graphify API; GlassyConfirmModal confirms removal

hyperedges.description: main.tsx creates React root and renders <App>, which renders <AppRoutes>. AppRoutes defines the full URL-to-component mapping with hierarchical layouts (RootLayout > PublicLayout/AppLayout/AdminLayout) and auth guards (ProtectedRoute, GuestRoute, AdminRoute). Map: / → HomePage, /pricing → PricingPage, /docs → DocsPage, /terms → TermsPage, /privacy → PrivacyPage, /community → CommunityPage, /login → GuestRoute>LoginPage, /register → GuestRoute>RegisterPage, /forgot-password → ForgotPasswordPage, /dashboard → ProtectedRoute>DashboardPage, /projects/new → ProtectedRoute>NewProjectPage, /workspace/:projectId → ProtectedRoute>WorkspacePage, /project/:projectId/settings → ProtectedRoute>ProjectMenuPage, /community/:projectId → CommunityProjectPage, /admin → AdminRoute>AdminOverviewPage, /admin/users → AdminRoute>AdminUsersPage, /admin/ai-runtime → AdminRoute>AdminAIRuntimePage, /admin/projects → AdminRoute>AdminProjectsPage.

AppRoutes wraps protected/admin routes with ProtectedRoute and AdminRoute components, and wraps login/register with GuestRoute. These guard components consume useAuthStore (Zustand) which holds user (User|null) and isAuthenticated (boolean). User type defined in client/types. ProtectedRoute likely checks isAuthenticated and redirects to /login; AdminRoute additionally checks user.role==='admin'; GuestRoute redirects authenticated users away from auth pages.

api.ts exposes typed HTTP methods (get/post/put/patch/delete) that wrap apiClient (axios instance at baseURL='/api', withCredentials=true). In development, vite.config.js proxies /api requests to http://localhost:3000 (the Fastify server). In production, Nginx likely serves both. Server is Fastify 5 with drizzle-orm + postgres (PostgreSQL) for data, argon2 for auth hashing, and @opencode-ai/sdk for AI integration. ApiError type bridges client error handling to server error responses.

nodes.label: AppRoutes — Route Definitions
nodes.description: React Router route tree: RootLayout wraps all routes. Public pages (home, pricing, docs, terms, privacy, community) under PublicLayout. Auth pages (login, register, forgot-password) under PublicLayout with GuestRoute. Protected app pages (dashboard, projects/new) under ProtectedRoute+AppLayout. Workspace (/workspace/:projectId) and ProjectMenu (/project/:projectId/settings) as full-viewport pages under ProtectedRoute. Community project (/community/:projectId) as read-only. Admin section (/admin, /admin/users, /admin/ai-runtime, /admin/projects) under AdminRoute+AdminLayout.

nodes.label: useAuthStore — Zustand Auth State
nodes.description: Zustand store holding user (User|null), isAuthenticated (boolean), setUser(user) sets both fields, logout() clears both. Used by ProtectedRoute, AdminRoute, GuestRoute guards.

nodes.label: apiClient — Axios Instance
nodes.description: Axios instance with baseURL='/api', withCredentials=true, Content-Type JSON header. Used by the api helper for all HTTP calls.

nodes.label: api — Typed HTTP Wrapper
nodes.description: Generic typed helper exposing get<T>, post<T>, put<T>, patch<T>, delete<T>. Each method wraps apiClient, catches Axios errors, converts to ApiError with statusCode/message, handles 204 as undefined. Throws ApiError on non-204 errors.

nodes.label: TypeScript Type Definitions
nodes.description: Core types: User (id, username, email, role, tier, aiTokens), Project (id, name, software, language, javaVersion, compiler, bridge, visibility, graphifyEnabled), CreateProjectInput, UpdateProjectInput, AgentSession/AgentSessionWithMessages, AgentMessage (+MessageMetadata/MessagePart), StreamingItem/StreamingState/StreamEvent, AIModel, TokenBalance, AdminStats, CommunityProject, ProjectAccess, FileTreeEntry, ApiError

nodes.label: Vite Build Configuration
nodes.description: Vite 6 config: @vitejs/plugin-react + @tailwindcss/vite plugins. Gzip + Brotli compression (threshold 1KB). Dev server on port 5173 with /api proxy to http://localhost:3000. Build uses Terser (drop_console, drop_debugger, passes=2, safari10 mangle). Manual code chunks: react-core, ui-libs, editor, markdown. Path alias '@' → './src'.

nodes.label: Client App TypeScript Config
nodes.description: Target ES2022, React JSX, strict mode, bundler module resolution, path alias @/* → ./src/*, noEmit, erasableSyntaxOnly

nodes.label: Drizzle ORM Config

nodes.label: Shared Base TypeScript Config
nodes.description: Target ES2024, ESNext module, bundler resolution, strict, skipLibCheck, isolatedModules, declaration+declarationMap+sourceMap. Extended by server/tsconfig.json.

nodes.label: Devcontainer Setup
nodes.description: AuroraCraft devcontainer: on postStart runs 'pnpm install && pm2 start ecosystem.config.cjs && pm2 save', forwards ports 3000 (server) and 5173 (client dev)

nodes.label: Minecraft Server Software Options
nodes.description: Three software categories: Game Servers (paper, purpur, pufferfish, folia, spigot, leaf, leaves, divinemc, pluto, aspaper), Hybrid Servers (mohist, arclight, magma, youer), Proxy Servers (velocity, bungeecord, waterfall, velocity-ctd). Exported as SOFTWARE_CATEGORIES, ALL_SOFTWARE_OPTIONS, SOFTWARE_LABELS, plus lookup helpers getSoftwareCategory and getSameCategorySoftware.

nodes.label: cn() — Tailwind Class Merge Utility
nodes.description: Combines clsx + tailwind-merge to merge tailwind classes. Standard shadcn/ui pattern.

nodes.label: Client ESLint Config
nodes.description: Flat config: ignores dist/, targets *.ts/tsx, extends js recommended + typescript-eslint recommended + react-hooks flat recommended + react-refresh vite. Browser globals, ES2020.

nodes.label: AuroraCraft Management Shell Script
nodes.description: Unified management script with menu (start/restart/stop/web). Manages PostgreSQL lifecycle (pg_isready), PM2 process management (ecosystem.config.cjs), health-check polling (/api/health on localhost:3000), Cloudflare tunnel guidance.
